# Get Net Worth Calculator

> Privacy-first financial benchmarking platform. Calculates exact net worth percentiles and age-based wealth distributions benchmarked against official US Federal Reserve SCF, UK ONS, Reserve Bank of India (RBI), Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), and Statistics Canada datasets. All calculations execute 100% client-side inside browser memory without data persistence.

## Core Calculators & Benchmarks

- [USA Net Worth by Age](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/net-worth-by-age-usa/): Benchmarked against official US Federal Reserve SCF data.
- [India Net Worth by Age](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/net-worth-by-age-india/): Benchmarked against RBI & SEBI Household Wealth datasets in INR Lakhs and Crores.
- [Australia Net Worth by Age](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/net-worth-by-age-australia/): Benchmarked against Australian Bureau of Statistics ABS and Superannuation data.
- [Net Worth by Income](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/net-worth-by-income/): Expected net worth formula benchmark based on Stanley's Millionaire Next Door formula.
- [UK Net Worth by Age](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/net-worth-by-age-uk/): Benchmarked against UK ONS Wealth and Assets Survey.
- [Canada Net Worth by Age](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/net-worth-by-age-canada/): Benchmarked against Statistics Canada SFS survey.
- [Average Net Worth by Age](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/average-net-worth-by-age/): Global benchmark guide comparing median vs average net worth across age brackets.
- [Net Worth Percentile Calculator](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/net-worth-percentile/): Exact wealth percentile rank calculator.
- [Am I Rich Calculator](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/wealth-class-calculator/): US Wealth Class and Tier Benchmarks.
- [FIRE Net Worth Calculator](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/fire-net-worth-calculator/): Financial Independence Retire Early milestone calculator.
- [Coast FIRE Calculator](https://getnetworthcalculator.com/coast-fire-calculator/): Early retirement coasting target calculator.
